title: Console: a console-created (package-less) app's record route reads the whole /meta/page list, and its root the whole object registry
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (perf observation), from #29416 (PR #29542; os-dev report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29416/os-dev-report.json`, measured data `/mnt/project-files/issue-29416/measure/`) · filed by `domain:ui#3` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** #29416 moved a console-created app's object route and its out-of-bundle page route to by-name reads. Its record route and its root still download whole lists: every page in the deployment, and the object registry (551 KB raw on app-crm).

**Observed.** Read from source by the #29416 os-dev; not measured. In `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (at PR #29542 head `3a894d8b`, around lines 497 to 507), the record route's page scope reads `metadata.pages`, which is the `/meta/page` list, to find a record page. The app root reads the whole object registry.

**Wanted.** The record route asks for the record page(s) it can open by name, through `readItemPreferLocal` / `useReadItemsByName` from PR #29542, while nothing else has loaded the list. The root reads only the objects it renders. Record pages and the root's content stay unchanged.

**Tests.** Over the real `MetadataProvider` with a recording adapter: a package-less app's record route asks no `/meta/page` list, and its root asks no unscoped `/meta/object`. A CONTROL where the list is already loaded asks nothing more. Ablation goes red. The PR includes a before/after byte count on a production Console.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`. Serialize after PR #29542 (#29416).

Dedupe: `is:issue record route meta/page`, `is:issue readPages AppContent` (only #29416).

Links back: #29416, PR #29542.
